references.why: Embedded verbatim inside Chrysostom's quoted letter ('the earth is the Lord’s'); rendered in reverent Luganda as «ensi ya Mukama». Not mined from the shipped Luganda corpus, so self_rendered for the reviewer to verify against the OLCB/Union tradition.
Near-verbatim allusion in the same letter ('Naked I came from my mother’s womb, naked shall I leave this world'); the letter adapts Job’s wording, so the rendering is the translator’s, not mined.

note: The only chapter:verse scripture is the two Old-Testament phrases Chrysostom quotes inside his own letter (the blockquote). Both are self_rendered in reverent Luganda; the lg corpus was not mined for them. His motto/doxology 'Glory be to God for all things' is his own words, translated as prose.
